action: CERT-AGID advises always checking the domain of authentication pages, and anyone who entered credentials on the fake page to change them promptly and check for unauthorised access or operations.
date_note: The CERT-AGID page gives its publication day; the fake domain is stated as registered on 22 November 2026.
exec: CERT-AGID says a fake InfoCamere login page collects user codes and passwords sent to a fraudulent server.
plain: A fake InfoCamere login page, reported by Italy's CERT-AGID, collects user codes and passwords. Only the username-and-password option on the page works.

sources.name: CERT-AGID: Phishing Infocamere volto al furto di credenziali

summary: CERT-AGID reports a phishing campaign that uses InfoCamere's name and logo to steal credentials. The fake page sits on a domain it says was registered on 22 November 2026 and copies InfoCamere's login; only the user-code and password option works, and it sends them to the fraudulent server. CERT-AGID says it notified InfoCamere and asked for the domain to be taken down.
title: CERT-AGID reports phishing page impersonating InfoCamere to steal login credentials

validation.note: Primary source: CERT-AGID's own page was read.

review.note: unsupported consequence removed from exec (register documents and paid services not on page); surface email-phishing -> unknown since page does not say how it is delivered
